high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a news article from Bloomberg Business, posted 18 hours prior to the capture of the screenshot. The headline reads: "UK introduces vape tax, scraps non-dom status in Jeremy Hunt’s budget." The article is attributed to Bloomberg.com, as indicated by the link at the bottom of the headline. The image features a man standing outdoors in front of a brick building with a white wall and a lamppost visible in the background. The man is dressed formally in a dark suit, a light blue shirt, and a light blue tie.
